That means I can't create the recurring job, and I also can't check whether a digest job already exists. Someone with Gateway admin access needs to fix that. Once it works, I'll set up the job and run a test post.

Two things to confirm when I set it up:
- **Time:** I'll schedule 08:00 Chicago time, the company time zone. Tell me if you meant a different zone.
- **Content:** #coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia), so combining them is fine. Because the digest is posted where the whole team can read it, it will leave out money terms such as rates, prices, discounts, contract values and invoice amounts. Those go to finance and the account owner. Seat counts, dates, tickets and contacts can stay in.
